pictures.author: Yair Haklai
pictures.observed: Pale pointed entry arcade, grey cylindrical stone shaft, faceted capital, deep plaster reveals beneath rubble/brick wall and modest lead cornice. Modern turnstiles excluded.

pictures.author: Giovanni Dall'Orto
pictures.license: Attribution-only permission on file page; viewed only
pictures.observed: Twin Kiosk exterior: open deep lower pointed arches, projecting upper bay with blue-green tile field and paired window levels, brick/stone alternating upper wall bands, perforated pointed screens, projecting pale cornice and several faceted lead domes. Lower external pool/terrace is host context, not reconstructed.

pictures.author: Karelj
pictures.observed: Open Queen Mother courtyard surrounded by cream/tiled lower arcades and two/three levels of windows, lower alternating pale/brown arch stones, slender shafts, projected dark eaves with braces and pale upper arched windows. Original wall art and inscriptions are not copied.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Imperial Harem relation4743322: exact notched multi-court footprint, stepped cream/stone service and apartment ranges, lead hip roofs, principal domed halls, smaller bath domes and chimney groups. Distinct Twin Kiosk frontage faces the mapped Courtyard of the Favourites with open lower pointed arches, striped brick/stone upper work, pale window screens and projecting muted blue-green tiled bay. Keep all three mapped courtyards open and retain independent Tower of Justice, Council Hall and every other palace member. No furnished apartments, copied wall/ceiling art or inscriptions, visitors, pool restoration or invented complete historic room inventory.
